explication: yt-dlp is a command-line and embeddable audio/video downloader. The main workflow accepts a URL or search request, extracts media metadata and available formats, selects downloads, transfers media, and optionally post-processes it into files. Its extractor, networking, downloader, and postprocessor layers are distinct; README capabilities also include playlists, subtitles, authentication, metadata changes, and format selection. The excerpts show orchestration and fragment handling, but not every integration, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
